title.en: Active Mobility (Certificate of Medical Need) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Certificate of Medical Need) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 27 February 2026.

heading.en: Sections 23I and 23J of Act — prescribed mobility vehicles
Grant of certificate of medical need

text.en:
4. A specified assessor may grant a certificate of medical need to an individual under section 23K of the Act by —
(a)submitting a duly completed electronic copy of the certificate of medical need to the Authority on behalf of the individual, in the form and manner specified by the Authority; or
(b)issuing a hardcopy of a duly completed certificate of medical need to the individual in the form specified by the Authority.
